title: LFM2-24B-A2B layer 4, early calendar-context expert for month arithmetic

evidence.claim: zeroing the part drops the 'month_successor' skill on held-out items more than random same-size parts
evidence.control: mean drop of 5 random same-size parts
evidence.note: ablation screen in the donor; matched control task changed by -0.0161

signature.label: early calendar-context expert for month arithmetic
signature.weight_rationale: L4 expert 43's router leans weekday (+.75) and against country/unit tokens. Its top router tokens are relational verbs (impose, constrain, accept, attract), which points to routing on context rather than on the month token itself. Attribution put it 1st (.481), and ablation gave .428 with control -.031.

skill.description: Name the month that comes k months after a given month (calendar month arithmetic). Control: integer successor with the same sentence frame.
skill.name: month_successor

status_reason: ablation evidence in the donor only; not grafted against a random control yet
